recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant wording unless a future finalized tracker changes CodeableConcept validation semantics or creates a new batch operation; follow FHIR-51050 separately if it reaches a final applied state.
issue_request: FHIR-7030 was a Published/Persuasive 2015 Vocabulary issue asking whether translation codes in a CodeableConcept input to ValueSet validation, especially batch validation, are allowed and evaluated. The resolution was to make clear that they are allowed and evaluated.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 5698, now git commit b67f0b8834b3800e3c2dd7c6e6f6bd08fdebda38, which changed the old ValueSet spreadsheet operation documentation to say a CodeableConcept validates true if one coding is in the value set and that multiple codings may be checked for conflicts.
additional_context: FHIR-8416 later removed dedicated batch validation operations in favor of the generic batch interaction, so the batch-specific row from the old spreadsheet is no longer current build surface. The active build has ValueSet enabled in source/fhir.ini and references OperationDefinition/ValueSet-validate-code from list-ValueSet-operations.xml. Later FHIR-51050 work on a possible new $validate-code-batch operation is unresolved and does not supersede the current $validate-code semantics.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml already says a full CodeableConcept validates true when one of its coding values is in the value set and may also validate conflicts when more than one coding is present.

related_jiras.note: Removed the old batch validation operation touched by FHIR-7030, explaining why current source retains only normal $validate-code semantics.
Proposes a new $validate-code-batch operation, but remains Waiting for Input and does not affect this applied/published seed decision.
